excerpt: Modern Animal is a membership-based veterinary clinic chain in California, Texas and other US states. Chewy agreed to acquire it in April 2026. Plans from $99 a year.
content:
Modern Animal runs veterinary clinics built around a membership and an app. Members get 24/7 virtual care by chat, video and phone, book visits in the app and use clinics designed to feel calmer for pets and owners. The clinics offer primary care, urgent care, vaccines, dental care, surgery, puppy and kitten care, senior pet care and a pharmacy. Its website lists locations in Los Angeles, Orange County, the San Francisco Bay Area, Denver, Austin, Dallas, Houston and Phoenix.

Modern Animal was founded by Steven Eidelman, who earlier founded the dog-tracking company Whistle and sold it to Mars Petcare, TechCrunch reported when Founders Fund led its $13.5 million round in 2019 ahead of its first Los Angeles clinic. Law firm Fenwick reported a $75 million Series C. In September 2025 Built In reported a $46 million Series D and said the company had 27 clinics across California, Texas and Colorado. On 8 April 2026 Chewy announced a definitive agreement to acquire Modern Animal, which then had 29 owned clinics and more than 100,000 member families, for an undisclosed price; Chewy said it expected the deal to add more than $125 million in annualised revenue and that Modern Animal would keep its operations, app and team. Modern Animal's homepage now says it has joined Chewy.

Modern Animal publishes its membership prices: the Essential plan costs $99 a year and includes one exam plus 24/7 virtual care, and the All Access plan costs $199 a year with unlimited visits without exam fees. The plans list exams and virtual care; other treatment is not listed as included.

We have not used Modern Animal for this page. It brings together Modern Animal's own website and the reporting linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from. Nothing here is paid placement.
